description: Anti-alias cap at the MCP3202 input pin
notes: 1.47 kHz with the divider's 6k Thevenin (10k||15k): the controller's copy of breath is band-limited at the module's 1.5 kHz mode (#32) and is not switched. 47 dB at 330 kHz on ADC_IN's own path; the R-78E5.0's ripple reaches the conversion through VDD = VREF, which this capacitor does not touch (breath-adc.md). C0G not X7R in a DC-accurate path. Murata GRM2165C1H183JA01D, LCSC C3848365

FITTED, on ADC_VDD beside C-DEC-ADC and C-ADC-VDD at U-ADC pin 8 (VDD, which IS the reference: the MCP3202 has no VREF pin), returned to AGND_INST. Part of the reference's filter with R-ADC-VDD (owner, 2026-10-03, D1; breath-adc.md). It does not filter LED PWM: that is E9's scope test, specified on breath-adc.md. Samsung CL31B106KBHNNNE (LCSC C89632), 10 uF X7R 50 V, the same part as C-REF-OUT

description: Series filter resistor from the dev board's 3V3 (DEV_3V3) to the MCP3202's VDD/VREF (ADC_VDD)
notes: D1 (owner, 2026-10-03: '10 ohm + 22 uF + 10 uF'). IN SERIES INTO U-ADC PIN 8, ahead of C-ADC-VDD, C-ADC-BULK and C-DEC-ADC, all three at the pin: the R-78E5.0's ripple reaches the conversion through VDD = VREF, and this RC is what holds it under E9's 2 LSB (breath-adc/sim vdd-ripple). The capacitance at the pin carries each conversion's current, so the resistor does not sag the reference inside one (vdd-load). R-CS-PULL-ADC stays on DEV_3V3, not ADC_VDD. UNI-ROYAL 0805W8F100JT5E, LCSC C17415, JLC basic [ds UNIROYAL-THICK-FILM-CHIP-RESISTOR-0805W8F.pdf]

description: Filter capacitor at the MCP3202's VDD/VREF, with R-ADC-VDD
notes: D1 (owner, 2026-10-03). AT U-ADC PIN 8 beside C-ADC-BULK and C-DEC-ADC, returned to AGND_INST at pin 4. 25 V in 1206 for its DC bias at 3.3 V: -20.5 % on Samsung's curve [web product.samsungsem.com CL31A226KAHNNN, 2026-10-03], inside the -40 % the sim varies it by. Samsung CL31A226KAHNNNE, LCSC C12891, JLC basic [ds SAMSUNG-CL31A226KAHNNNE-SPECSHEET.pdf p.1]

description: Lower leg of the 0.6x divider from the breath buffer to the ADC
notes: LOWER LEG, to the instrument analog star. 15k against the 10k upper leg is the 0.6x that lands sensor-full-scale inside a 3V3 ADC's range. The RATIO is what matters, so buy both legs from one reel

description: Upper leg of the 0.6x divider from the breath buffer to the ADC
notes: UPPER LEG, AND >=10k IS THE SPEC, NOT THE VALUE: below that, 5V-before-3V3 sequencing pushes about 2.5 mA into the ADC's ESD clamp on every power-up. It also has to leave C-AA-ADC time to settle, which is what stops the leg going higher still. Divide AFTER the buffer, never before

SOIC-8. VDD-referenced so no separate ref chip. 50ksps at 3V3 vs 4-8kHz needed. CH1 TIED TO AGND_INST (owner, 2026-10-03, D5): a known zero for a self-test. VDD = VREF is ADC_VDD, behind R-ADC-VDD | 2026-09-21, from Microchip DS21034F now at datasheets/analog/MCP3202-CI-SN.pdf: fCLK max is 1.8MHz at VDD=5V and 0.9MHz at VDD=2.7V, WITH NO 3.3V ROW. The 0.9MHz the design uses is therefore the GUARANTEED 2.7V MAXIMUM, not an interpolation - two documents called it an interpolation and it is strictly conservative at 3.3V, with ~25% of unclaimed headroom (straight-line to 3.3V gives ~1.14MHz). Both rows are characterised, not 100% tested. ALSO A MINIMUM NOBODY HAD: the sample cap holds charge for at least 1.2ms at 85C, so effective fCLK >= ~10kHz - which forecloses 'slow the ADC down' as a way to buy loop time. Sample cap 20pF with 1k switch resistance; tSAMPLE is 1.5 clock cycles and source impedance adds directly to it, so the buffer ahead of it is load-bearing

description: CS_ADC's pull-up, IO39 to the dev board's 3V3
notes: BESIDE U-ADC PIN 1, from IO39 (CS_ADC) to DEV_3V3. Holds the ADC deselected from reset until the firmware drives the pin. IO39 is MTCK: its internal pull-up at reset depends on EFUSE_DIS_PAD_JTAG, and with that fuse burned the pin floats [ds ESP32-S3-datasheet-v2.2.pdf p.17-18, note 7], so the board does not lean on it. Same part as R-CS-PULL-INST: 0805W8F1002T5E, LCSC C17414
